gloss: advance announcement of a crime; threat

definitions.gloss: advance announcement of a crime; (online) threat
definitions.explanation: A message announcing in advance that one will commit a crime, such as an attack or bombing, often posted online. Making one is itself an offense, typically treated as obstruction of business.

examples.japanese: {犯行予告|はんこうよこく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: A threat announcing a crime arrived.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{犯行予告|はんこうよこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}き{込|こ}んだ→書き込む：04599_kakikomu⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A man who posted a crime threat online was arrested.

examples.japanese: ⟦{爆破|ばくは}→爆破：13518_bakuha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{犯行予告|はんこうよこく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{休校|きゅうこう}→休校：19880_kyuukou⟧になった。
examples.english: The school was closed because of a bomb threat.

notes:
⟦{犯行|はんこう}→犯行：13472_hankou⟧ (criminal act) + ⟦{予告|よこく}→予告：08379_yokoku⟧ (advance notice). A common term in news reports, especially about threats posted on social media or sent by email.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {犯行予告|はんこうよこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ / ⟦{書|か}き{込|こ}む→書き込む：04599_kakikomu⟧: to make / post a threat
- ⟦{爆破|ばくは}→爆破：13518_bakuha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{犯行予告|はんこうよこく}: a bomb threat
- {犯行予告|はんこうよこく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}される→逮捕する：26830_taihosuru⟧: to be arrested for making a threat
